LanguageData.RFS_Title: Ranged Firepower Stats — DPS by range
LanguageData.RFS_OpenDescription: Compare sustained ranged damage using this pawn's current stats and weather.
LanguageData.RFS_Cycle: {0} × {1} shots / ({2} aim + {3} burst + {4} cooldown + {5} scheduling ticks) × 60 = {6} DPS (attack check: {7} ticks)
LanguageData.RFS_Interval: Nominal inter-shot interval: {0} ticks (verb value: {1}). Pawn stance/equipment tick ordering shortens the first gap by one tick; later gaps have a one-tick minimum.
LanguageData.RFS_IdealShooter: No pawn: ideal shooter accuracy, normal aim 100%, specialist aim from loaded role/trait defs. Trigger-happy accuracy penalties require choosing a real pawn.
LanguageData.RFS_StandardConditions: Current equipment, health, genes, skills and stats; standard standing body-size-1 target, clear weather, no cover/smoke. Open the table for current weather.
LanguageData.RFS_TableAssumptions: Standard standing body-size-1 target; current weather and shooter stats. No cover, smoke, armor or darkness offsets in this distance-only table. The selected-target row uses vanilla ShotReport for its actual position.
LanguageData.RFS_Limitations: Primary pre-armor damage; no acquisition, rearming or extra damage. Includes 1.7 attack-check cadence (camera-dependent). Pawn first-gap overlap: −1 tick; later gaps ≥1 tick.
LanguageData.RFS_TurretTiming: Turret timing uses mean warmup plus cooldown and burst gaps. Excludes the up-to-14-tick target scan wait and ammunition work; sustained potential, not measured wall-clock DPS.
LanguageData.RFS_Unsupported: Exact single-target expectations depend on explosion, scatter and projectile mechanics. Available primary burst damage is shown separately.
LanguageData.RFS_Fuel: Maximum primary damage per ammunition resource: {0}. Uses fuel multiplier and fuel consumed per shot/burst.
LanguageData.RFS_OpenHint: Use the DPS range table button at the bottom of this card for a comparison table.
LanguageData.RFS_TargetHint: Optional: choose a map pawn for a vanilla ShotReport estimate, including cover, smoke, body size, posture and darkness. Values below remain the standard distance comparison.
LanguageData.RFS_NeedIdeology: Enable Ideology to compare shooting specialists.
LanguageData.RFS_GraphHover: Hover over the plot to inspect the values at each distance.
LanguageData.RFS_GraphReference: Clear-weather reference, matching the info-card distance table. DPS is primary damage before armor.
LanguageData.RFS_GraphSnapshot: Same snapshot as the range table. Standing body-size-1 target, {0}; no cover, smoke, armor or darkness offsets. DPS is primary damage before armor.
LanguageData.RFS_GraphShooterNote: Shooter accuracy only, matching the native accuracy table. Weapon accuracy, target conditions and weather are excluded.
